latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan: risk-off morning ahead of Tuesday's Fed decision — holding steady, no trades
latest_messages.body: Cautious tape (oil +9% on the week revives inflation worry; live FOMC Tue 9/16 ~55-65% hike). All 3 holdings' theses intact. Watching ATI (~1% above its stop). No buys before the Fed — MDT is the top candidate to reconsider after Tuesday.

latest_messages.headline: Week ending 2026-09-11: -1.10% | SPY -0.78% | alpha -0.32% | grade C
latest_messages.body: Third soft week, but each smaller and zero mistakes made. ATI (-5.6% on the week) was the whole story - metals sector, not a company problem. Bought CFR (a rate-benefiting bank) - proof we learned last week's lesson. Holding into Tuesday's Fed decision.

latest_messages.headline: Close: equity $98,579 · day +0.59% · SPY +0.86% · alpha -0.26%
latest_messages.body: Green day but lagged a broad rally - our defensive bank/metals names didn't leap with the risk-on crowd. No trades; all stops resting. Watching ATI (weakest, stop nearest). FOMC Tuesday is the big event.

latest_messages.headline: CPI came in benign - market opened green - holding, no buys
latest_messages.body: August inflation wasn't as hot as feared, so the tape opened up. Ran the bench (MDT, ETN) against live data - nothing cleared our 70 gate, and cash is at the ~$10k floor. Patience into FOMC 9/16.

latest_messages.headline: CPI day - the week's binary event, hawkish setup
latest_messages.body: August inflation report at 8:30 ET was the day's swing factor. Plan: react to the print, don't pre-position. No trades pre-market. Bank tilt kept; rate-sensitive software shelved.

latest_messages.headline: Quiet down day into CPI - no trades
latest_messages.body: Market drifted lower ahead of inflation data. Held all positions; stops resting. ATI still our weakest, thesis intact.

latest_messages.headline: Bought Cullen/Frost (CFR), a Texas bank - filled a conviction slot
latest_messages.body: Deployed into CFR, a rate-benefiting regional bank, with a -7% safety stop. Same nervous market as two weeks ago but the opposite, correct choice vs a rate-sensitive name.

latest_messages.headline: Buying Cullen/Frost (CFR) - a Texas regional bank
latest_messages.body: Opened a starter position in CFR at $163.15, 60 shares, with an automatic -7% safety-sell. It benefits from higher rates - a fit for this rate environment.
